- Large pot or Dutch oven
- Large skillet
- 9x13 inch baking dish
- Mixing bowl
- Wooden spoon
- Sharp knife
- Measuring cups and spoons

Instructions:

1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.

2. In a large pot or Dutch oven, cook the ground beef and Italian sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking up any large chunks with a wooden spoon.

3. Add the chopped onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes until the onion is translucent.

4. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, chopped basil, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using). Simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.

5. While the sauce is simmering, cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.

6. In a mixing bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, grated Parmesan cheese, beaten eggs, and chopped parsley. Mix well.

7. To assemble the lasagna, spoon a layer of the meat sauce into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Add a layer of cooked lasagna noodles on top (about 4-5 noodles).

8. Spread a layer of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles, followed by a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese.

9. Repeat the layers of meat sauce, noodles, ricotta cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese until all ingredients are used up, ending with a layer of meat sauce on top.

10. Sprinkle additional shredded mozzarella cheese over the top of the lasagna.

11. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.

12. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the noodles are tender.

13. Let the lasagna cool for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.

Introduction:
Succulents are low-maintenance plants that require minimal care and are perfect for those with limited gardening experience. They are also very versatile and can be grown in almost any container, making them ideal for your very own DIY succulent garden. In this tutorial, we will show you how to create a beautiful and sustainable succulent garden using recycled materials.

Materials:
- A container (such as a tray, wooden box, or tin can)
- Pebbles or rocks for drainage
- Cactus/succulent soil mix
- An assortment of succulent plants
- Decorative stones or colored sand (optional)

Step 1: Choose a Container 
Before starting, choose a suitable container for your succulent garden. You can repurpose anything from an old tray, wooden box, or tin can. Just make sure it has drainage holes to prevent waterlogging.

Step 2: Add Drainage Pebbles
To help your succulents grow healthy roots, place a layer of pebbles or rocks at the bottom of the container. This will ensure proper drainage, preventing excess water from causing root rot or fungus.

Step 3: Fill the Container with Soil Mix 
Fill the container with a cactus/succulent soil mix, ensuring that the soil isn’t too compact. Succulents prefer well-draining soil, so add perlite or sand if necessary.

Step 4: Position Your Plants 
Place your plants in the container, leaving enough space between each plant to allow for growth. Be sure to arrange them in a way that will create an aesthetically pleasing design.

Water your succulent garden sparingly, allowing the soil to dry before watering again. Overwatering can be detrimental to the health of your plants, so only water when the soil is completely dry.

Add decorative stones or colored sand to enhance the overall appearance of the garden. This will also help retain moisture and protect the roots of the plants.

The best location for your succulent garden is a well-lit area, but not in direct sunlight. South-facing windowsills or a covered patio are great options.

Ingredients:
- 1 pound of Arborio rice
- 4 cups of mushroom broth or vegetable broth
- 1/2 cup of white wine
- 1 pound of sliced mushrooms (use whatever variety you prefer, but I recommend using a combination of cremini, shiitake, and oyster mushrooms)
- 1/2 cup of grated Parmesan cheese
- 1/4 cup of unsalted butter
- 1/4 cup of chopped shallots
- 2 cloves of minced garlic
- 2 tablespoons of olive oil
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Optional garnishes: chopped parsley, grated Parmesan cheese, and sautéed mushrooms

Instructions:

1. In a large heavy-bottomed pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and sauté them until they are golden brown and crispy. Set aside.

2. In the same pot, melt the butter and sauté the chopped shallots and minced garlic until they are translucent and fragrant.

3. Add the Arborio rice to the pot and stir it for 2-3 minutes until the grains are coated in butter and become slightly golden.

4. Pour in the white wine and stir continuously until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid.

5. Begin ladling in the mushroom broth one cup at a time, stirring continuously and allowing each cup of broth to be fully absorbed by the rice before adding the next. This process should take around 20 minutes.

6. After you’ve added all the broth, taste the rice to ensure it is cooked through but still slightly al dente. If it’s still too firm, add a little more broth or water and continue stirring and cooking.

7. Once the rice is cooked through, add the sautéed mushrooms, grated Parmesan cheese, and salt and black pepper to taste. Stir everything together until cheese is melted and incorporated.

8. To achieve a creamy consistency, continue stirring the risotto with a wooden spoon or silicone spatula until it becomes thick, creamy, and almost soupy.

9. When your desired consistency is reached, remove the risotto from heat and allow it to sit for a few minutes.

10. Serve the risotto hot with additional Parmesan cheese, sautéed mushrooms, and chopped parsley as desired.

user: Please provide a step-by-step guide for making whole wheat pita bread with olive oil, including the necessary ingredients, measurement instructions, cooking time and temperature, and any additional tips or variations for flavor.
response:
Ingredients:
- 3 cups whole wheat flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp active dry yeast
- 1 cup warm water
- 2 tbsp olive oil

Instructions:

1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and salt.

2. In a separate small mixing bowl, dissolve the active dry yeast in warm water. Allow it to sit for about 5 minutes until the mixture becomes frothy.

3. Add the yeast mixture and olive oil to the large mixing bowl with the flour mixture.

4. Mix the ingredients until the dough becomes firm.

5. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.

6. Place the dough in a large, clean mixing bowl and cover it with a damp towel. Leave the dough to rise for approximately one hour.

7. Preheat your oven to 475°F.

8. Divide the dough into equal portions.

9. Roll each piece to approximately 1/4 inch thickness.

10. Place the rolled-out dough onto a parchment paper-lined baking sheet.

11. Bake for 5-7 minutes until the pita bread has puffed up and the outer shell has turned golden brown.

12. Remove from the oven and allow it to cool for a few minutes before serving.

Additional Tips:
- You can add extra flavor to the pita bread by adding herbs, spices, or garlic to the dough before baking.
- You can also use all-purpose flour instead of whole wheat flour for a lighter texture.
- You can brush the pita bread with olive oil or butter for extra flavor before serving.
- Store them in an airtight container to keep them fresh.

user: Provide detailed step-by-step instructions on how to create a rustic DIY headboard using reclaimed wood planks for a queen-sized bed. Include measurements, necessary tools, and recommended finishing techniques for a polished look.
response:
Materials:
- 6-8 reclaimed wood planks, approximately 5 feet in length and 6-8 inches in width
- 2x4 lumber, cut to the width of the headboard
- Wood screws (2 inches in length)
- Sandpaper
- Wood stain and brush or rag
- Clear polyurethane sealer and brush

Tools:
- Saw (hand or power)
- Drill with drill bits
- Measuring tape
- Square ruler
- Pencil
- Safety glasses
- Work gloves

Step-by-Step Instructions:

1. Measure the width of your queen-sized mattress frame. Subtract a few inches from this measurement to allow for the headboard to extend slightly beyond the frame on either side.

2. Cut the 2x4 lumber to fit this width, and then cut additional pieces to attach vertically in-between (typically two to three should suffice), to create a sturdy backing to attach the planks to. Pre-drill holes for screws every few inches along the length of the 2x4s.

3. Arrange your reclaimed wood planks side-by-side to determine the order and pattern you would like. Flip them over and lay the 2x4s on the back, lining them up along the top and bottom edges of the planks.

4. Using the pre-drilled holes, screw the 2x4s into the planks using the 2-inch wood screws. Make sure to countersink them slightly to allow for filling and sanding later.

5. Once the back is attached, turn the headboard over and use sandpaper to smooth out any rough spots or splinters on the front side.

6. Apply a coat of wood stain to the planks using a brush or rag, following the manufacturer's instructions. Allow to dry completely before adding a second coat if desired.

7. Once the stain has dried, use a clear polyurethane sealer to protect the wood and add a polished finish. Apply at least two coats, following instructions for drying time and sanding between coats.

8. Allow the sealer to dry completely before attaching the headboard to your bed frame, typically done by screwing it to the studs in the wall behind the bed or by using special mounting hardware.

And that's it! With a little elbow grease, reclaimed wood planks, and some basic tools, you can have a beautiful rustic headboard to perfectly complement your bedroom decor in no time at all.

user: Create a Ruby program that calculates the Jaccard similarity score between two input strings. The program should take two user inputted strings, remove any punctuation and whitespace, and then create sets of the unique words in each string. The Jaccard similarity score should be calculated as the size of the intersection of the two sets divided by the size of the union of the two sets. The program should then output the Jaccard similarity score rounded to two decimal places.
response:
# Function to clean and tokenize input strings
def clean_and_tokenize(string)
  string.downcase.gsub(/[\W_]/, ' ').split.uniq
end
 
# Function to calculate Jaccard similarity score
def jaccard_similarity(string1, string2)
  set1 = clean_and_tokenize(string1)
  set2 = clean_and_tokenize(string2)
  intersection = set1.intersection(set2).size
  union = set1.union(set2).size
  intersection.to_f / union.to_f
end
 
# Get user input
puts "Input string 1:"
string1 = gets.chomp
puts "Input string 2:"
string2 = gets.chomp
 
# Calculate and output Jaccard similarity score
jaccard_score = jaccard_similarity(string1, string2)
puts "Jaccard similarity score: #{'%.2f' % jaccard_score}"

user: How do you properly store fresh herbs to keep them fresh for longer periods?
response:
1. Refrigerator: Fresh herbs can be stored in the refrigerator to keep them fresh for a longer period. To do so, wash them gently with cold water, shake off any excess moisture, and then wrap them in a damp paper towel. Place the wrapped herbs in a plastic bag with a few holes punched in it.

2. Glass jar with water: Another option is to treat the herbs like a bouquet of flowers. Trim the stems and place the herbs in a glass jar filled with water, covering the stems. Then loosely cover the top with a plastic bag or wrap and refrigerate.

3. Freeze: Herbs can be stored in the freezer for later use. Chop them up and freeze them in an ice cube tray with water or oil. Once they are frozen, remove them from the tray and store them in a freezer-safe bag or container.

4. Drying: Drying herbs in the air or oven can also be effective for preserving them. Tie the stems together and hang them upside down in a dry, dark place for a few days until they are dry. Alternatively, spread the herbs on a baking sheet and dry them in a low-temperature oven (around 100-110 degrees Fahrenheit) for a few hours until they are dry and crisp. Store them in an airtight container.

Question/Instruction: What are the potential consequences for automakers if the U.S. New-car market's growth streak comes to an end?

Given material: Big sales of loaded F-150 pickups helped push Ford's profits to record levels last quarter. But if the U.S. New-car market is stalling after years of growth, Ford's profit growth could stall as well. Image source: Ford Motor Company.
A new forecast predicts that U.S. Auto sales will decline in May. Are we at the end of the industry's long growth cycle?
A joint forecast by analysts at J.D. Power and LMC Automotive predicts that sales of "light vehicles" (the industry term for cars, pickups, and SUVs) in the U.S. Will total 1,539,500 units in May, down 5.7% from 1,632,354 in May of last year.
To some extent, the analysts say, that drop is due to a quirk of the calendar. The industry counts "selling days" excluding Sundays and holidays, on the assumption that many U.S. Auto dealers are closed on those days. May 2016 has two fewer "selling days" than did May of last year. Total vehicle sales were actually up 2% on a "selling-day-adjusted" basis, the analysts said.
But either way, the analysts concede, sales are running behind the forecasts that were made early in 2016. "Given that performance is running just behind expectations, LMC Automotive is reducing its total light-vehicle forecast for 2016 to 17.7 million units from 17.8 million units," the analytics firm said in a statement on Thursday.
In other words: We may be at the top of the cyclical growth curve.
Since the end of the last recession, auto investors have become accustomed to big year-over-year U.S. Sales increases. Nearly all of the major automakers have seen sales grow nicely in the important and lucrative U.S. Market in recent years. The pace of growth slowed somewhat last year, but companies like Ford (5.3% increase in 2015) and General Motors (7.8% increase) still managed to find good growth in the U.S. -- and good profits, too.
Those profits might stay strong for a while longer, as buyers continue to shift away from (less profitable) sedans toward (more profitable) SUVs. But it's possible that the U.S. New-car market's growth streak may be coming to an end, and that could cause automakers' profit growth to stall.
To be clear, that's not a disaster. Automakers are cyclical businesses; anyone investing in an automaker should be prepared for the fact that the sales-growth cycle will end at some point. And companies like Ford and GM (and most of their rivals) are well prepared for a downturn, with ample cash reserves to sustain product development if and when profits flatten.
But if that point is now, then it may be tough for many of the automakers to post quarterly profit growth for a while -- and that means that the stocks are likely to stall as well.
It's also possible that the market will end up doing better than the forecast, as the analysts who prepared it freely admit.
In other words, if the automakers are aggressive with their Memorial Day promotions, May might turn out better than the forecast suggests. But it's also possible that this is the inevitable beginning of tougher times for the automakers. We'll watch it closely.

Given material: Audi AG is developing a device the size of an iPad that will pack all the computing power needed for a car to drive itself without crashing. Audi's zFAS mother board will control all of the autonomous functions of the carmaker's future vehicles and process data from sensors and imagery. The driver assistance controller (zFAS) board will act as the central interface for all piloted driving functions. It is expected to go into mass production in about two years and will "work its way into the model range step by step in the foreseeable future," Audi said. "It is a key milestone on the road to new, automated driving functions and a demonstration of the pioneering role that Audi is assuming in the field of piloted driving," Audi said. Today, most driver assistance computer systems are a conglomeration of spatially separated controllers. Audi claims its zFAS will be the first board to control autonomous functions in a central domain architecture. The computing power of the zFAS corresponds to the complete electronics architecture of a well-equipped mid-size car, Audi said. "Thanks to the high degree of integration, the new board is barely the size of a tablet PC. Its modular concept makes the zFAS flexible scalable and thus future-proof in every respect," Audi stated. For example, route optimization software reduces fuel consumption and CO2 emissions by providing real-time routing solutions that consider factors such as traffic, weather, and road conditions. Similarly, smart inventory management systems enable real-time tracking of goods, improving accuracy and reducing the risk of loss or damage in transit.

Moreover, smart transport systems allow logistics managers to employ predictive analytics to analyze vast amounts of data generated by various sources, such as weather services, supply chain partners, and customer reviews. Predictive analytics provide insights on demand forecasting, inventory management, and supply chain optimization. By predicting demand for goods or services, logistics managers can optimize inventory levels, reducing storage costs while ensuring that goods are always available for customers.

Smart transport systems are not without challenges. One of the biggest challenges is the cost implications of deploying these systems. Deploying and integrating smart transport systems requires a significant investment in technology, infrastructure, and personnel. Moreover, the integration of different systems and technologies may also require integration costs. However, these costs are offset by the potential cost savings that these systems deliver.

Another major concern for the logistics industry is cybersecurity. However, logistics managers can mitigate this risk by developing robust cybersecurity frameworks, training personnel on security best practices, and ensuring that all systems are up-to-date with security patches.

Noelle Nelson professor of marketing and consumer behavior at the University of Kansas School of Business. She and her colleague Joseph Redden at the University of Minnesota tried to think outside the lunch box.

user: Write an essay discussing the function and properties of gap junctions and non-gap junction electrical synapses in the nervous system. Include examples of each type of synapse and explain how they differ in terms of transmission speed, connectivity, and regulation. Additionally, analyze the advantages and disadvantages of using electrical synapses compared to chemical synapses in neural communication. Use scholarly sources to support your arguments and provide a clear conclusion.
response:
The nervous system comprises interconnected neurons that signal to one another through the release of neurotransmitters at synapses. Neurons communicate through two broad types of synapses, namely electrical synapses and chemical synapses. Electrical synapses connect neurons through gap junctions, whereas chemical synapses transmit neurotransmitters across the synaptic cleft. This essay discusses the function and properties of gap junctions and non-gap junction electrical synapses in the nervous system, highlights their differences in transmission speed, connectivity, and regulation, and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of using electrical synapses compared to chemical synapses in neural communication.

Gap junctions are specialized protein channels that allow direct electrical communication between neurons. They are composed of two hemi-channels, or connexons, each contributed by two neighboring cells. These channels permit the diffusion of ions and small molecules between neurons, enabling quick, synchronized neural firing. Gap junctions are essential in regions requiring fast and synchronic cell-to-cell communication such as the retina, the inferior olive, and the hypothalamus (Kiehn et al., 2010). For example, the inferior olive, which controls motor coordination, houses electrically coupled neuron clusters robustly interconnected through gap junctions (Kiehn et al., 2010).

Non-gap junction electrical synapses, on the other hand, do not possess gap junctions. Instead, they permit synaptic transmission through various types of channels, including potassium channels or nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. Non-gap junction electrical synapses are slower, bidirectional, and more adaptable than gap junction electrical synapses, permitting adjustment of synaptic weights relative to nearby synapses (Lodder et al., 2019). An example of non-gap junction electrical synapses is found in the globus pallidus pars interna (GPi), a neural cluster that coordinates movement. The GPi contains neurons coupled through nicotinic acetylcholine receptor channels, which permit excitation and inhibition of GPi neurons via the cholinergic basal ganglia input (Kita & Kita, 2012).

In terms of transmission speed, gap junctions are faster than non-gap junction electrical synapses as they permit direct, rapid diffusion of ions between neurons. However, non-gap junction electrical synapses are bidirectional, ensuring that both neurons transmit signals back and forth (Lodder et al., 2019). In terms of connectivity, gap junction electrical synapses are mainly found in neurons with similar functions or in clusters of neurons performing the same task. This connectivity pattern permits quick synchronization of coordinated firing patterns in neural clusters. In contrast, non-gap junction electrical synapses permit broader interconnectivity, enabling modulatory communication between neurons with different functions (Kita & Kita, 2012).

One of the main benefits of electrical synapses over chemical synapses is that they have faster transmission times. This property is essential in regions that require synchronized firing patterns such as the retina, where electrical synaptic transmission enables close coordination of adjacent neurons. Additionally, electrical synapses allow for more efficient energy use, as they eliminate the need for presynaptic vesicle release, diffusion across the synaptic cleft, and postsynaptic receptor binding (Lodder et al., 2019). However, electrical synapses do not enable features of chemical synapses, such as plasticity and modulation of synaptic efficacy by presynaptic firing. Additionally, as electrical synaptic currents passively spread to nearby neurons, they enable easier spread of pathological activity compared to chemical transmission.

In conclusion, gap junctions and non-gap junction electrical synapses serve different connectivity functions within the nervous system. Gap junctions facilitate synchronization of firing patterns in neurons with similar functions, while non-gap junction electrical synapses enable modulatory communication between neurons with different functions. Although electrical synapses confer faster and more efficient signaling than chemical synapses, they offer fewer features such as plasticity and modulation of synaptic efficacy. Further research is necessary to understand the dynamics of electrical synapses and how their properties could be utilized more effectively in various neural circuits. 

References:

Kiehn, O., Imre, G., Wilson, J. M., & Barrière, G. (2010). Electrical wiring of the mammalian brain. Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 11(1), 17–30. Doi: 10.1038/nrn2732

Kita, H., & Kita, T. (2012). Cortical stimulation evokes abnormal responses in the dopamine-depleted rat basal ganglia. Journal of Neurophysiology, 107(3), 995–1006. Doi: 10.1152/jn.01095.2011

Lodder, J. C., Owald, D., & Sigrist, S. J. (2019). Excellent connections: gap junctions in memory and cognition. Developmental neurobiology, 79(3), 251–263. Doi: 10.1002/dneu.22638

The first step in making a delicious smoothie is to gather all the necessary ingredients. The beauty of a pantry smoothie is that you can get creative and experiment with different combinations depending on what you have in stock. Here are some suggestions of ingredients that go well together;

- Frozen fruits such as strawberries, blueberries, mangoes, or bananas
- Fresh fruits such as apples, pears, oranges, or kiwis
- Leafy greens such as spinach, kale, or collard greens
- Nut butters such as almond or cashew butter
- Seeds such as hemp, chia, or flaxseeds

- Sweeteners such as honey, maple syrup, or agave

2. Select Suitable Equipment

To make a smoothie, you need a blender. Any blender will work, however, the higher the power of the blender, the smoother your smoothie will be. You will also need a measuring cup and spoon for measuring your ingredients.

3. Prepare the Ingredients

Before you start blending, make sure to prepare your ingredients. Clean and chop your fruits and vegetables into small pieces. Measure out the required amount of nut butter, seeds, or sweetener.

4. Add Your Ingredients to the Blender

Once you have all your ingredients prepared, add them to the blender. Start with the liquid first, then add the fruits, vegetables, nut butter, seeds, and sweetener.

5. Blend Until Smooth

Blend your ingredients on high speed for 1-2 minutes or until the smoothie is smooth and creamy.

6. Taste and Adjust

Taste your smoothie and adjust based on your preferences. If it's too thick, add some more liquid. If it's too sweet, reduce the amount of sweetener.

7. Serve and Enjoy

- Dried fruit like dates or raisins are also a great option to add natural sweetness.

- Nut butters and seeds: These are a good source of healthy fats, fiber and protein.
- Milk and yogurt: These are a good source of calcium, vitamin D, and protein.
- Sweeteners: Use natural sweeteners like honey or maple syrup which are packed with antioxidants and minerals.

Customizing the Smoothie to Meet Varying Dietary Needs:

If you have any dietary restrictions, here are a few ways you can customize your smoothie recipe:

- Vegan or lactose intolerant: Substitute milk with a plant-based milk like almond or soy milk.
- Gluten-free: Make sure all your ingredients are gluten-free.
- Low-fat or low-calorie: Use skim milk or non-fat yogurt instead of full-fat milk or yogurt.

Use credible sources to support your claims and include personal anecdotes or quotes from individuals who have experienced the benefits of a gratitude journal.
response:
In today’s hectic and busy world, it’s easy to forget the positives and focus on the negatives in life. We can get caught up in our day-to-day struggles and forget to be grateful for the small things that make our lives good. This is where keeping a gratitude journal comes in handy. A gratitude journal is a diary where you document the things that you are grateful for. It can be as simple as the sun shining in the morning or as complex as the love of your family. There are numerous reasons why you should start a gratitude journal, and here are a few.

Firstly, keeping a gratitude journal can have a positive impact on your mental health. Researchers have found that gratitude can change the way our brains work and help to reframe negative thinking. The act of reflecting on things we are grateful for helps us to focus on the positives in our lives, which can improve our mood and self-esteem. Additionally, keeping a gratitude journal reduces stress and anxiety by helping us to see the good in every situation. As we focus on the things that make us happy, we become more optimistic, which further boosts our mental well-being. By taking a few minutes each day to write down what we are grateful for, we can create a more positive outlook on life.

Secondly, a gratitude journal can have a positive impact on our relationships. Research has shown that being grateful for the people in our lives can improve our relationships with them. Practicing gratitude can help us to be more empathetic, compassionate, and understanding toward others. When we express gratitude to our loved ones, we are sending a message to them that we value them and appreciate their presence in our lives. This can help to build stronger connections and improve communication. By keeping a gratitude journal, we can become more aware of the people in our lives and show them how much they mean to us.

Lastly, a gratitude journal can increase our overall life satisfaction. Reflecting on what we are grateful for can help us to appreciate the little things in life that make us happy. By focusing on the positives, we become more mindful, and we start to enjoy life more. As we create a more positive mindset, this can lead to more meaningful experiences and deeper connections with those around us. By writing down our gratitude each day, we are creating a roadmap to a more fulfilling life.

In conclusion, keeping a gratitude journal can have numerous benefits for our mental health, relationships, and overall life satisfaction. By taking a few minutes each day to reflect on the things we are grateful for, we can reframe negative thinking, build stronger relationships, and enhance our well-being. Getting started is easy, and all you need is a notebook and a pen. Simply write down a few things you are grateful for each day, and watch your life transform into something more positive and fulfilling.

Personal Story:

“I started keeping a gratitude journal about six months ago, and it has made a world of difference in my life. Before I started the journal, I was struggling with anxiety and depression. I found myself constantly focusing on the negatives in my life and was unable to see the good. However, as soon as I started my gratitude journal, I noticed a shift in my mood. I found myself becoming more aware of the little things that made me happy, like the sound of birds chirping in the morning or the taste of my favorite coffee. As I continued to write down what I was grateful for each day, I became more mindful and present in my life. I started to appreciate the people around me more, and my relationships with them improved exponentially. Overall, my gratitude journal has helped me to create a more positive mindset and has given me a newfound appreciation for life.” – Jessica, 27.

user: Please write a comprehensive guide that outlines step-by-step instructions for conducting thorough and effective site speed audits for SEO purposes. This guide should provide detailed explanations of common site speed issues, the tools and techniques necessary for identifying these issues, and strategies for optimizing site speed. In addition to practical instructions, the guide should also offer best practices and recommendations for presenting audit findings and communicating recommendations to clients or stakeholders in a clear and actionable way. Finally, please ensure that the guide is written in a concise, accessible, and engaging style that makes it easy for users with varying levels of technical knowledge to follow and understand.
response:
Introduction:

A fast loading website is crucial for user experience and search engine optimization. It is crucial to conduct a site speed audit to identify issues that may be holding back your site's speed. In this guide, we will discuss how to conduct a thorough and effective site speed audit for SEO purposes.

Step 1: Analyze the Current Site Speed:

To identify the issues, start by analyzing the current site speed. One of the best tools for this purpose is Google’s PageSpeed Insights. It is a free online tool that analyzes the website's speed and provides suggestions to improve it. In addition, you can also use tools like GTmetrix, Pingdom, or YSlow.

Step 2: Identifying Site Speed Issues:

The site speed audit will identify the following issues:

1. JavaScript and CSS Files:
The large number of JavaScript and CSS files may negatively impact the site speed. Combining these files and minimizing them can help optimize the site's speed.

2. Image optimization:
Large images can slow down site speed. Optimize images and compress the size without sacrificing quality.

3. Server Response Time:
The slow server response time can significantly affect site speed. Work with the hosting provider to explore options to improve server speed.

4. Caching:
Caching is temporary storage of frequently accessed content, which can speed up site loading times. Enable browser caching of files whenever possible.

Step 3: Review Server and Hosting Configuration:

Discuss the site speed with your hosting provider. Confirm that the server is configured optimally and identify ways to optimize the configuration if necessary.

Step 4: Identify Unused Resources:

Unused content or plugins on the website can increase load times. Identify these resources and remove the unnecessary ones.

Step 5: Consider Mobile Site Speed:

The rise in mobile internet usage warrants particular attention to mobile site speed. Use Google’s Mobile-Friendly Test tool to evaluate mobile site speed and identify issues.

Step 6: Develop a Plan for Site Speed Optimization:

Based on the findings of the site speed audit, develop a plan to address and overcome the identified issues. Include practical solutions that can be implemented.

Step 7: Communicate Recommendations:

Site speed audit findings and recommendations will likely be shared with multiple stakeholders, including clients or in-house teams. Ensure that the recommendations are presented in a clear and actionable format that all stakeholders understand and can implement.

Conclusion:

A thorough site speed audit will provide a roadmap of optimizations to enhance site speed for better search engine ranking and user experience. Follow the steps outlined above to conduct a comprehensive site speed audit that delivers actionable recommendations.

user: Write a 1000-word personal essay in MLA format exploring the ways in which the mind can be stronger than the body. Your essay should include personal anecdotes and examples to support your argument. Use literary devices such as imagery, metaphor, and simile to enhance your writing. Additionally, provide at least two scholarly sources to supplement your argument.
response:
The mind is a powerful tool that governs our actions, thoughts, and beliefs. It is the source of our imagination, creativity, and intelligence. It allows us to perceive and interact with the world around us. While the body can be limited by physical constraints, the mind can overcome obstacles, achieve goals, and push through barriers. I have personally experienced the incredible strength of the mind, and I believe that it can be stronger than the body in many ways.

One example of the mind's strength over the body is in the area of sports. Athletes frequently train their minds to push past the pain, fatigue, and discomfort that comes with intense physical activity. Their ability to remain focused and motivated, despite physical limitations, is what often separates the best from the rest. An excellent example of this is swimmer Michael Phelps, he was one of the most decorated Olympians of all time. Phelps stated that he made sure to visualize his races, every race he swam, he imagined himself winning. He focused on the minutest details like the number of strokes, breathing, and kicking. In his memoir, Phelps writes that this visualization technique and mental preparation were what pushed him to excel beyond his limits.

Additionally, I believe that the mind can be stronger than the body in dealing with pain, illness, or injury. When someone is facing a chronic illness or a severe injury, their mind must be strong enough to get them through the difficult times. I remember being hospitalized for a severe kidney infection when I was fifteen. I was in terrible pain and could barely move, but I refused to let my condition defeat me. Instead, I forced myself to focus on positive thoughts, to be grateful for the support of my family and friends, and to believe that I would overcome the illness. This positive mindset, alongside proper medical treatment, allowed me to fully recover in a shorter time than my doctors originally anticipated.

Meditation techniques are one of the ways to train the mind to overcome physical discomfort or pain. Yoga and meditation schools teach participants to focus on their breath and to let thoughts and sensations come and go without attaching themselves to them. They enjoin practitioners to be in the present moment, rather than focusing on the past or the future, which can cause excessive worrying and anxiety. When a person focuses on the present moment, physical pain can become less intense, and they can more effectively deal with it without spiraling out of control. Practicing yoga and meditation enabled me to cope with debilitating panic attacks and chronic anxiety in a more holistic and sustainable way. Rather than solely relying on medication, I used my mind's strength to overcome my mental and emotional health challenges.

Another area where the mind can demonstrate its extraordinary strength is in a person's ability to control their emotions. People who are emotionally intelligent are better equipped to handle interpersonal conflicts, stress, and negative emotions like anger, fear, and sadness. When a person can remain calm and not let their emotions dictate their actions, they can make better decisions and avoid potentially damaging behaviors. I have personally experienced how having emotional control helps you make better choices. Once, during a heated argument with a close friend, I could feel my anger boiling over, my fists balled up and my heart-rate increasing. However, I decided to take a step back and center myself. I focused on my breath and repeated a calming mantra to myself. This allowed me to think more clearly, to express my feelings in a more constructive way and to find a mutually beneficial solution to our disagreement.

Moreover, the mind can be stronger than the body when it comes to learning and intellectual achievements. Studies have shown that the brain's neural pathways can be strengthened, and new ones created, through cognitive training and engaging in mentally stimulating activities. While genetics play a role in determining innate intelligence, a person's environment and experiences can influence how their brain develops. For example, people who learn a new language or musical instrument later in life can show measurable improvements in cognitive ability, memory, and attention span. This highlights how the mind can continuously improve and adapt even as the body ages.

While the mind is a powerful tool, it is critical to note that it is not invincible. Mental health conditions like depression and anxiety can consume a person's mind and significantly affect their quality of life. It is essential to seek professional help when such mental health conditions arise. It is also important to note that the mind's strength is not a replacement for proper medical treatment in instances of physical illness or injury.

In conclusion, the mind can be stronger than the body in many ways. The strength of the mind can help athletes, patients recovering from an illness, those dealing with chronic pain, emotionally charged situations, and intellectual pursuits. Focusing on positive thoughts, visualization techniques, meditation, and cognitive training can help a person develop a strong and resilient mind. People must care for both their body and their mind, as both are essential to lead a healthy, balanced life. The mind and the body are interconnected, and learning to harness the strength of both can help us achieve our goals and live a meaningful life.

user: Write step-by-step instructions for making a basic cheese omelet, including the ingredients needed and the necessary cooking tools. Make sure to include proper cooking techniques for beating eggs, heating a skillet, and folding the omelet. Additionally, suggest optional toppings or additions for the omelet, such as vegetables, meats, or spices. Consider writing the instructions in a clear and concise style, with easy-to-follow bullet points or numbered lists.
response:
Ingredients:
- 2 eggs
- 1/4 cup shredded cheese (cheddar, mozzarella, or any other cheese of your choice)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1 tablespoon butter

Tools:
- Mixing bowl
- Whisk or fork
- Non-stick skillet
- Spatula

Steps:
1. Crack two eggs into a mixing bowl.
2. Add 1/4 cup of shredded cheese to the bowl.
3. Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
4. Whisk or beat the eggs with a fork until they are fully combined and the mixture is a uniform color. 
5. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of butter and let it melt, distributing it evenly around the pan.
6. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet, using the spatula to ensure that the mixture is evenly distributed throughout the pan.
7. Cook until the omelet begins to set and the bottom is a light golden brown color, about 2-3 minutes.
8. Once the bottom is cooked, use the spatula to fold the omelet in half by gently lifting one half and folding it over the other. 
9. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
10. Carefully slide the omelet onto a plate and serve hot.

Optional toppings or additions:
- Sautéed vegetables (such as onions, bell peppers, mushrooms, or spinach)
- Diced ham or bacon
- Salsa or diced tomatoes
- Fresh herbs (such as chives or parsley)
- Hot sauce or sriracha

user: Could you suggest some of the latest and most effective weight loss strategies I can implement in my daily routine, and how to monitor my progress?
response:
1. Intermittent Fasting - This is a popular strategy that involves restricting your eating to specific hours of the day, such as a 16:8 fast. This can lead to a calorie deficit and help with weight loss.

2. High-intensity interval training (HIIT) - This involves short, intense bursts of exercise followed by periods of rest. It can be an effective way to burn calories and increase metabolism.

3. Eating a balanced diet - Focus on eating nutrient-rich foods, such as lean protein, whole grains, fruits, and vegetables. Avoid processed foods and added sugars.

4. Mindful eating - Pay attention to your body’s hunger and fullness signals. Eat slowly and savor your food.

5. Drink more water - Consuming water can help you feel full and reduce calorie intake. Aim to drink at least eight glasses of water a day.

6. Keep track of your progress - Use a journal or app to log your food, exercise, and weight. This can help you stay accountable and motivated.

7. Get enough sleep - Sleep is essential for weight loss. Aim for at least seven hours of sleep per night.

8. Reduce stress - Chronic stress can lead to weight gain. Find ways to reduce stress, such as yoga or meditation.

9. Stay consistent - Remember that weight loss takes time and consistency. Stick with healthy habits and be patient with yourself.

10. Consult with experts - Seek advice from your doctor or a registered dietitian to ensure you’re on the right track.

user: How does the Food and Agriculture Organization ensure that small-scale farmers are not left behind in the wake of climate change?
response:
The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) ensures that small-scale farmers are not left behind in the wake of climate change in the following ways:

1. Promoting Climate-Smart Agriculture: The FAO promotes climate-smart agricultural practices that allow small-scale farmers to adapt to and mitigate the effects of climate change. This includes practices such as conservation agriculture, agroforestry, and sustainable land management.

2. Capacity Building: The FAO supports the capacity building of small-scale farmers through training and extension services. This provides small-scale farmers with the knowledge and skills to make informed decisions and adopt climate-smart agricultural practices.

3. Access to Finance: The FAO works to improve small-scale farmers' access to finance through microfinance initiatives and risk-sharing mechanisms. This enables small-scale farmers to access credit and insurance to invest in climate-smart agriculture, which can help them adapt to climate change and build resilience.

4. Advocacy: The FAO advocates for the inclusion of small-scale farmers in national and international climate change policy discussions. This ensures that their voices are heard and their interests are represented in the development of climate change policies and strategies.

Overall, the FAO recognizes the critical role that small-scale farmers play in global food security and in addressing climate change. By providing support and advocacy, the FAO works to ensure that small-scale farmers are not left behind in the wake of climate change.

user: Write a short story about a character who learns to value simplicity and minimalism.
response:
Once upon a time, there was a woman named Anna. She was always busy, always on the go, and always surrounded by things. Her house was filled with clutter, her wardrobe was overflowing with clothes, and her schedule was packed with appointments and social events. Anna thought that the key to happiness was having more - more money, more possessions, and more experiences. But despite all her efforts, she always felt dissatisfied.

One day, Anna decided to take a break from her hectic life and went on a camping trip. As she sat by the campfire and looked up at the stars, she felt a sense of peace she had never felt before. She realized that she didn't need all the material things she had been chasing after to be happy. In fact, they were just weighing her down.

When Anna returned home, she started going through her belongings and getting rid of things she didn't need. She donated clothes to charity, sold some of her furniture, and cleared out her pantry. The more she simplified her life, the more she felt free. She found that she had more time to enjoy the things that really mattered, like spending time with her family, pursuing her hobbies, and exploring the outdoors.

Anna learned to value simplicity and minimalism because it brought her happiness and peace. She realized that the rat race she had been caught up in was just an illusion, and that true fulfillment came from living a simple, meaningful life. From that day on, she embraced the concept of "less is more" and inspired others to do the same.

user: Write an analytical report on the extent to which automation technologies influence customer retention, and how this impacts business success. Include information on both the positive and negative effects, as well as any strategies or best practices for managing customer relationships in an automated environment. Use relevant case studies, data, and scholarly sources to support your analysis.
response:
Introduction:

As technology continues to advance and businesses aim to streamline their operations, many have turned to automation technologies to improve their efficiency and reduce costs. However, there is a growing concern among some that automation may damage customer relationships and negatively impact customer retention rates, which in turn could harm business success. The purpose of this report is to examine the extent to which automation technologies influence customer retention, discuss the positive and negative effects, and outline strategies and best practices for managing customer relationships in an automated environment.

Positive Effects of Automation on Customer Retention:

1. Improved customer experience - Automation technologies can provide customers with a seamless experience, allowing them to access information and services instantly. This can result in improved customer satisfaction levels, which in turn can lead to increased loyalty and retention rates.

2. Personalization - Automation technologies can enable businesses to personalize their interactions with customers, tailoring products and services to their specific needs and interests. This can create a stronger emotional connection between the customer and the brand, increasing customer loyalty and retention.

3. Efficient problem resolution - Automation technologies can provide customers with quick and efficient problem resolution, reducing the time and effort required of customers to resolve issues. This can lead to increased customer satisfaction and improved retention rates.

Negative Effects of Automation on Customer Retention:

1. Loss of human touch - Automation technologies can reduce the personal connection between businesses and their customers, which can negatively impact customer loyalty and retention rates.

2. Security concerns - Automation technologies can also create security concerns, with customers may be hesitant to provide sensitive information online. This can lead to lower retention rates as customers may seek out companies that provide more secure methods for sharing information.

3. Technical difficulties - Automation technologies can be prone to technical difficulties, leading to frustration for customers when they cannot access information or services. This can lead to lower customer satisfaction levels and retention rates.

Strategies and Best Practices for Managing Customer Relationships in an Automated Environment:

1. Maintain a human touch - To counteract the negative effects of automation, businesses should strive to maintain a human touch in their interactions with customers. This can be done through personalized emails, phone calls, and other forms of communication that allow for a more personal touch.

2. Educate customers - When using automation technologies, businesses should make sure their customers are fully informed about the information and services available. This can be achieved through the use of clear and concise language, user-friendly interfaces, and education campaigns.

3. Address security concerns - To address customer concerns about security when using automation technologies, businesses should invest in secure payment and data management systems. This can help to build trust and increase retention rates.

Case Studies:

1. Amazon - Amazon is a prime example of a company that has successfully used automation technologies to improve customer retention. The company's recommendation system uses complex algorithms to suggest products that customers are likely to buy, based on their search history and purchasing behavior.

2. Delta Air Lines - Delta Air Lines has implemented an automated chatbot that can answer customer questions and provide assistance on various issues without the need for human intervention. This has improved the customer experience by providing a quick, efficient service.

Conclusion:

In conclusion, automation technologies can have both positive and negative effects on customer retention rates. While automation can improve the customer experience and increase loyalty, it can also lead to a loss of personal connection and potential security concerns. To manage customer relationships in an automated environment, businesses should strive to maintain a human touch, educate customers, and address security concerns. Finally, companies that successfully leverage automation technologies, such as Amazon and Delta Air Lines, can improve customer retention rates and drive business success.

user: Please write a step-by-step guide on how to make homemade vegetable broth from scratch, including a list of necessary herbs and spices and their respective amounts. The guide should also include instructions on how to store the broth and how to use it in various recipes. Please ensure that the language used is easy to understand for those with little to no cooking experience.
response:
Homemade Vegetable Broth Recipe:

Ingredients:
- 2 onions
- 4 carrots
- 4 celery stalks
- 1 bulb of garlic
- 2 bay leaves
- 1 tsp peppercorns
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1 tsp dried rosemary
- 1 tbsp salt 
- 12 cups of water

Instructions:

1. Clean and chop the vegetables into large pieces. The size doesn't matter too much, as they will be boiled down.

2. In a large pot, add the vegetables and all of the herbs and spices.

3. Pour water over the vegetables, making sure they are fully covered.

4. Bring the water and vegetables to a rolling boil.

5. Once the mixture has reached a boil, reduce the heat to a low simmer for 2-3 hours. During this time, the broth will reduce and become more concentrated.

6. Taste the broth and add more salt or spices if needed.

7. Once the broth is ready, remove it from the heat and let it cool for 30 minutes.

8. Strain the broth through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth, discarding any solids.

9. Let the broth cool to room temperature before storing it in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week, or freeze it for later use.

How to use vegetable broth:

1. Use it as a base for soups, stews, or sauces.

2. Use it to cook grains, such as rice or quinoa, for added flavor.

3. Use it in place of water when cooking vegetables or meats.

These requirements include recognition as a sovereign state by other states and a willingness to abide by the objectives and principles of the United Nations.

3. Recommendation: If the UN determines that the applicant meets the requirements for membership, it submits a recommendation to the General Assembly for a vote.

4. Vote: The General Assembly then holds a vote to determine whether to admit the country as a member of the United Nations. The process for voting varies depending on the situation, but generally involves a two-thirds majority vote of the General Assembly.

5. Admission: If the country is admitted, it becomes a member of the United Nations General Assembly and is granted access to all the privileges and responsibilities of membership, including the ability to participate in the work of the United Nations, vote on issues, and make proposals.

This approach can not only help increase customer retention but also enhance customer satisfaction, bolster reputation, and drive sales. In this evaluation, we will take a closer look at the potential benefits of implementing proactive customer service in the finance industry.

Increased Customer Retention:

One of the primary benefits that financial institutions can expect to see from proactively providing customer service is increased customer retention. When customers feel valued and supported by their financial institution, they are more likely to remain loyal. This will also reduce churn rates and save on customer acquisition costs. Furthermore, loyal customers can provide valuable word-of-mouth marketing, which can lead to further growth and revenue.

Improved Customer Satisfaction:

When customers are regularly contacted about their account and their questions and concerns are addressed before becoming an issue, they will feel cared for and valued. This approach also demonstrates that the financial institution is invested in the customer's success and works to ensure their satisfaction. Enhanced Reputation:

A proactive approach to customer service can also boost a financial institution's reputation. As customers appreciate the improved service, they are more likely to share their experiences with others positively. This can result in increased brand awareness, new customers, and further strengthen the company's reputation in the market, leading to increased sales and growth.

Increased Sales:

For example, by reaching out to customers proactively and informing them of new products, offers, and services, customers will be more likely to take advantage of the opportunities being presented.

Several methods and channels can be used to provide proactive customer service in the finance industry. The most effective strategies include:

2. Leveraging data and analytics: Financial institutions can use data and analytics, customer feedback, and account activity to anticipate when customers might need additional support. This information can be used to proactively contact the customer to discuss concerns or provide information to address their needs.

3. Multi-Channel Customer Support: Multi-channel customer support makes it easy for customers to reach out and get assistance through multiple points of contact. Customers can use email, live chat, phone or social media channels to communicate, engage and get the help they need.

3. Leverage Technology solutions: The integration of advanced and intelligent support technology solutions to streamline and engage better customer support activities.

4. Incorporate a feedback loop: A feedback loop is also essential in proactive customer service. This feedback concerning customer support helps track areas of potential improvement and ensures that the desired results are being achieved.

user: Provide step-by-step instructions for making homemade harissa with roasted peppers and chili flakes, including the necessary ingredients, equipment, and cooking techniques. Additionally, discuss variations in the recipe, such as adjusting the spice level or incorporating different herbs and spices. Provide tips for storing and serving the finished product, as well as suggested dishes that pair well with harissa. Use clear and concise language with descriptive imagery to help the reader visualize the cooking process.
response:
How to Make Homemade Harissa with Roasted Peppers and Chili Flakes

Ingredients:
- 3 red bell peppers
- 3-4 dried chili peppers
- 3-4 garlic cloves
- 1 tablespoon coriander seeds
- 1 tablespoon cumin seeds
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- ½ teaspoon salt
- Juice of half a lemon
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- Water, as needed

Equipment:
- Oven
- Baking sheet
- Food processor or blender

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Cut the red bell peppers in half, remove the seeds and core, and place them cut side down on a baking sheet.
3. Roast the peppers in the oven for 25-30 minutes until their skins are blistered and blackened.
4. While the peppers are roasting, soak the dried chili peppers in hot water for 10-15 minutes until they are soft and pliable.
5. Drain the chili peppers and remove their stems and seeds.
6. Toast the coriander and cumin seeds in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant, for about 1-2 minutes.
7. In a food processor or blender, combine the roasted peppers, chili peppers, garlic, toasted coriander and cumin seeds, smoked paprika, salt, lemon juice, and olive oil.
8. Process the ingredients until smooth, adding water as needed to achieve your desired consistency.
9. Taste the harissa and adjust the seasoning as needed, adding more chili flakes for extra heat or additional herbs and spices for more flavor.

Variations:
- Spice level: To make the harissa milder, use fewer chili flakes or remove the seeds from the dried chili peppers before adding them to the mix. For a spicier harissa, use more chili flakes or add some fresh chili peppers.
- Herbs and spices: You can customize the flavor of your harissa by adding other herbs and spices such as mint, parsley, cilantro, or ginger. You can also experiment with different types of paprika or add a pinch of cinnamon or nutmeg for a warm and aromatic note.
- Roasting method: If you don't have an oven or want a quicker method, you can roast the peppers under the broiler or on a gas stove-top. Simply place the peppers on a hot skillet or directly on the gas flame and turn them with tongs until they are charred on all sides. 

Storage and serving tips:
- Harissa can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to one month. The oil may separate, so simply stir it back in before using.

response:
Vegan Lentil and Sweet Potato Curry Recipe

Ingredients:
- 1 cup of dry brown lentils
- 2 medium-sized sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
- 1 tablespoon of olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 red bell pepper, chopped
- 3 cloves of garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon of fresh grated ginger
- 2 teaspoons of ground cumin
- 1 teaspoon of ground coriander
- 1 teaspoon of paprika
- 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper
- 1 (14 oz.) can of diced tomatoes, with juice
- 1 (14 oz.) can of coconut milk
- Salt and pepper, to taste
- Fresh cilantro, for garnish

Instructions:

1. Rinse the lentils under running water and place them in a pot with 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until the lentils are tender. Drain and set aside.

2. In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper and cook for about 5 minutes, until softened.

3. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.

4. Add the sweet potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.

5. Add the diced tomatoes with their juice and the coconut milk. Stir to combine.

6. Add the cooked lentils and stir to combine.

7. Bring the curry to a simmer and let it cook for 15-20 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender.

8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

9. Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.

Alternative ingredients/substitutions:

- You can use green or red lentils instead of brown lentils.
- If you don’t have sweet potatoes, you can use regular potatoes or butternut squash instead.
- If you don’t have fresh ginger, you can use ground ginger instead.
- If you don’t have canned diced tomatoes, you can use fresh tomatoes instead.
- If you don’t have coconut milk, you can use almond milk, cashew cream or any other plant-based milk.

Cooking tips:

- To make the curry extra spicy, add more cayenne pepper or chili flakes.
- To make the curry creamier, add a tablespoon of cashew butter or coconut cream.
- If you have leftovers, store them in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 3 months.

Side dish recommendations:

- Naan bread
- Basmati rice
- Quinoa
- Roasted vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, etc.)

Serving size:

This recipe serves 4-6 people.

Enjoy your warm and delicious vegan lentil and sweet potato curry with your family and friends!

Read the passage below and answer the question or follow the instruction: What is the Global Action Plan, and how does it fit into Movember's mission to fund prostate cancer research?

Passage: Movember cofounder Adam Garone describes how to grow a massive charitable community by bringing the fun.
Adam Garone never thought a silly beer-fueled bet to grow a mustache would turn into a multi-million-dollar global charity and the largest non-governmental funder of prostate cancer research.
Seven years later, Movember expects more than 600,000 men to ask their friends to contribute donations in exchange for growing an artful caterpillar lip in the annual Movember mustache challenge, which starts Nov. 1.
“The main driver for people participating in Movember is because it’s fun,” says cofounder Garone, who has meticulously trimmed guilt-laden messages from their campaign in favor of irreverence, a slick barbershop-style web design, and two blow-out parties that bookend the month.
As Movember has grown from a hobby to a movement, Garone says he’s learned to create out-of-the box evangelizing strategies for Movember newbies or cut large checks without personally overseeing performance.
Indeed, Movember packs in all the trimmings of a good time. The fundraising website is a sea of silly profile pictures (like from the 2010 Mo Mo Award winner, pictured here, who sports a neon pink mustache).
The annual “Moscars” YouTube video competition garners some impressively professional-looking submissions from eager shavers looking to win the top prize of premium razors.
In addition to about 60 official parties hosted around the world, Movember supplied around 10,000 MoBros and MoSistas last year with a party in a box, complete with award sashes and prizes to honor the most dedicated and creative mustaches.
Behind its party-hearty exterior, Movember has created a sophisticated, organized process that makes messaging and coordination easy for participants. Despite the popularity of social media, Garone estimates that 75% of team donors are recruited through email.
“We spend a lot of time trying to make everyone’s life when they’re participating in Movember as simple as possible,” says Garone, who designed Movember.com for easy integration with social media, lots of downloadable content, and, perhaps, most important, scripted letters to help participants ask for donations via email.
The central website serves as a all-in-one dashboard for coordinating activity: Participants can organize teams of fundraisers, style their “Mo Space” with clever pictures and jokes, demonstrate their fundraising progress, and encourage supporters to share the campaign for social media friends.
“For us, it’s all about participation, and really the funds come off the back of participation,” says Garone, who says Movember prioritizes the volume of members over concentrating on big fundraisers or celebrities. An estimated 30% of peach-fuzzed participants won’t even raise a single dollar, and Movember is explicit about not coercing them into minimum fundraising goals.
The all-inclusive approach has discovered an unexpected gold mine: girls. “While it’s a masculine brand, the girls are actually the most important part of this, because they make up a majority of the team captains and 65% of the donors,” Garone said.
Girls, for obvious physiological reasons, can’t chase the Movember dream of matching Hulk Hogan’s famous trucker ‘stach. But they can participate as “captains” who help organize and spread the word about fundraising.
The web strategy has been so successful that it has caught the attention of Google, which just released a brand-new commercial with Movember as the star.
As one of the biggest prostate cancer funders in the world, Movember’s mission is maturing into one of industry-wide influence, outlined in their Global Action Plan.
“The biggest learning,” Garone says, was not to simply cut checks to cancer foundations. “We’ve taken far, far more control,” he says, in the hands-on management and influence of Movember’s sizable purse. Like other mega-philanthropists we’ve written about, Garone wants researchers and organizations to work collaboratively. “Movember is absolutely uniquely placed to smash up the rules and bring them all together,” he says.
Author Greg Ferenstein is taking the Movember dive! Follow him as he grows his first mustache.

Movember's Global Action Plan is a strategy for industry-wide influence in prostate cancer research funding. It involves hands-on management and collaboration between researchers and organizations to maximize the impact of their sizable purse. Can you summarize the common myths about the stock market that are addressed in the given text material?: When fiascos like the Enron bankruptcy, auditing scandals and analysts’ conflict of interest occur, investor confidence can be at an all-time low. Many investors are wonder whether or not investing in stocks is worth all the hassle. At the same time, however, it’s important to keep a realistic view of the stock market. Regardless of the real problems, common myths about the stock market often arise. Here we go over these myths in order to bust them.
1) Investing in stocks is just like gambling.
Assessing the value of a company isn’t an easy practice. There are so many variables involved that the short-term price movements appear to be random (academics call this the Random Walk Theory); however, over the long term, a company is only worth the present value of the profits it will make. In the short term a company can survive without profits because of the expectations of future earnings, but no company can fool investors forever – eventually a company’s stock price can be expected to show the true value of the firm.
2) The stock market is an exclusive club in which only brokers and rich people make money.
Many market advisors claim to be able to call the markets’ every turn. The fact is that almost every study done on this topic has proven that these claims are false. Most market prognosticators are notoriously inaccurate; furthermore, the advent of the internet has made the market much more open to the public than ever before. All the data and research tools previously available only to brokerages are now there for individuals to use.
Actually, individuals have an advantage over institutional investors because individuals can afford to be long-term oriented. The big money managers are under extreme pressure to get high returns every quarter. Their performance is often so scrutinized that they can’t invest in opportunities that take some time to develop. Individuals have the ability to look beyond temporary downturns in favor of a long-term outlook.
3) Fallen angels will all go back up, eventually.
• XYZ made an all time high last year around $50 but has since fallen to $10 per share.
• ABC is a smaller company but has recently gone from $5 to $10 per share.
Which stock would you buy? Believe it or not, all things being equal, a majority of investors choose the stock that has fallen from $50 because they believe that it will eventually make it back up to those levels again. Thinking this way is a cardinal sin in investing! Price is only one part of the investing equation (which is different from trading, whch uses technical analysis). The goal is to buy good companies at a reasonable price. Buying companies solely because their market price has fallen will get you nowhere. Make sure you don’t confuse this practice with value investing, which is buying high-quality companies that are undervalued by the market.
Below is a chart of Nortel’s decline. Imagine how much money you would have lost had you bought Nortel just because it kept on hitting new lows!
4) Stocks that go up must come down.
The laws of physics do not apply in the stock market. There is no gravitational force that pulls stocks back to even. Over ten years ago, Berkshire Hathaway’s stock price went from $6,000 to $10,000 per share in a little more than a year. Had you thought that this stock was going to return to its lower initial position, you would have missed out on the subsequent rise to $70,000 per share over the following six years.
Below is a chart of Wal-Mart from 1997 to 2000. We’ve circled every time the stock chart hit resistance to reaching a new high. Those investors who were waiting for the stock to come back to earth would missed out on a return of 500% or more. What’s behind the stock? It’s the company! Wal-Mart is another example of an excellent company that has dominated its industry by being innovative and creating value for both shareholders and customers.
5) Having just a little knowledge, because it is better than none, is enough to invest in the stock market.
Knowing something is generally better than nothing, but it is crucial in the stock market that individual investors have a clear understanding of what they are doing with their money. It’s those investors who really do their homework that succeed.
Don’t fret, if you don’t have the time to fully understand what to do with your money, then having an advisor is not a bad thing. The cost of investing in something that you do not fully understand far outweighs the cost of using an investment advisor.
Forgive us for ending with more investing clichés, but there is another old adage that is very much worth repeating: “What’s obvious is obviously wrong.” This means that knowing a little bit will only have you following the crowd like a lemming. Like anything worth anything, successful investing takes hard work and effort. A partially informed investor is about as effective as a partially informed surgeon; he or she will only hurt themselves and those around them.

Ingredients:
• 2 cups broccoli florets
• 1 red bell pepper, sliced
• 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced
• 1 onion, chopped
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
• 3 tablespoons soy sauce
• 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
• 1 tablespoon sesame oil
• 2 cups cooked quinoa

2. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.

5. Add the soy sauce and rice vinegar to the pan and stir until the vegetables are coated.
6. Cover the pan and let the vegetables steam for 5-7 minutes or until they are cooked but still have a slight crunch.
7. Once the vegetables are cooked, remove the pan from heat and allow the stir-fry to cool for a few minutes.
8. Serve the stir-fry on a bed of cooked quinoa, garnished with chopped cilantro or green onions.

 * Function to check if a number is a palindrome or not
 * 
 * @param int $number The input number to check
 * @return string Returns a message indicating whether the input number is a palindrome or not

function check_palindrome($number) {
  // Validate input as a positive integer greater than zero
  if (!is_numeric($number) || $number <= 0 || strpos($number, '.') !== false) {
    return "Error: Input must be a positive integer greater than zero";
  }
  // Convert input number to string
  $number_str = (string)$number;
  // Reverse the string
  $reverse_str = strrev($number_str);
  // Compare the original and reverse strings
  if ($number_str === $reverse_str) {
    return "Yes, ".$number." is a palindrome!";
  } else {
    return "No, ".$number." is not a palindrome!";
  }
}

Oh, Canada, what are you doing?

Here's what happened to me yesterday: the KFC Waffle Double Down. Eight years after the dawn of the original Double Down—a breadless sandwich constructed of two fried chicken patties stacked around bacon, cheese, sauce, and whole lot of media teeth-gnashing over the excess of it all—KFC Canada announced the birth of a sibling sandwich with a Belgian waffle core drizzled with maple aioli "a sweet nod to KFC’s Canadian fans," per a press release from the company.
The original incarnation had done spectacularly well, selling 350,000 sandwiches across the country in its first ten days to become KFC Canada's best-selling new menu item of all time. I was in Toronto speaking at a food symposium this week, and took a long stroll down Dundas St. One afternoon to catch a little flavor of the city. Crossing an intersection, I was slightly baffled when I saw Colonel Sanders' face emblazoned on a giant chicken bucket outside a franchise, and even more perplexed to see the sign below touting a Waffle Double Down, which we don't have in the States. I grew up in Kentucky, and while the company amputated the state from the restaurant's name in the '90s, when it needs to, it'll lean into kitchy Kentuckiana. It's my born duty to see how my home state is being repped abroad.
It sounded like a gloriously extravagant sandwich and I wanted to get my gaping American maw around one as soon as physically possible, but I'd just eaten lunch. The next day, I set out from my hotel on a quest to increase my personal bliss via fried chicken, which—if I'm being honest with myself—wouldn't be the first time. I sought out a KFC closer to me in the slightly schmancy Urban Eatery food court of the Eaton Centre, giddily selected the latter when offered "regular" or "spicy" (might as well sign on for the full sensory onslaught, what with the potential brevity of mortal existence and whatnot), and handed over my $10.50 CAD. Several minutes later (presumably they had to craft the "real" Belgian waffle as touted on the electronic sign), with trembling hands, I bore my prize to a tall counter seat, unwrapped it, photographed it, lifted it to my slavering mouth, and took a hearty bite.
There's no reason on Earth that this should be the case. No one is looking to KFC to be a pillar of health in the food firmament; their sole job is to make food that's freaking delicious while it fills you up. They're historically fantastic at that. Chicken and waffles—the dish it's based on—is, too. It's a savory-sweet pas de deux with a rich cultural history and what should be a foolproof formula for delight. It's got the crunchy, salty, spiced bite of the fried skin giving way to juicy, tender chicken, then crisply-griddled batter and pillowy dough pocketed with sumptuous syrup. Hot sauce inevitably plays nice with it. Even if you're stuffed to the gills, your body begs you to take one more bite, just for the sensory thrill of it.
Canada, I’m so very sorry. As a longtime Kentuckian and a mostly-proud American, I feel the need to apologize that we haven’t shared our very best junk food with you. Air plants, scientifically known as Tillandsia, are low-maintenance plants that can add a touch of greenery to any living space with their unique look. They are epiphytes, which means they don't require soil to grow as they absorb water and nutrients from the air. As easy as they are to care for, there are still some best practices to follow to ensure they thrive for years to come. Here's a comprehensive guide on how to take care of and sustain air plants:

Selecting the Perfect Environment

Air plants can thrive in a variety of environments, from bright, indirect light to lower-lit areas. They can be grown indoors or outdoors, depending on where you live. Here are some tips for selecting the perfect environment for your air plants:

1. Light: Air plants need bright, indirect light to thrive. Ideally, you should place your air plant somewhere where it can get bright, filtered light, such as near a window. Avoid exposing your air plants to direct sunlight, as it can scorch the leaves.

2. Temperature: Air plants prefer temperatures between 50-90°F (10-32°C). Ensure the temperature in the room is not below 50°F (10°C) to avoid damage to the plant.

3. Humidity: Air plants need a humid environment to grow. If you live in a dry area, you can use a pebble tray or a humidifier to keep the humidity levels up.

Watering Your Air Plants

Watering your air plants is one of the most important elements of their care. Despite their name, air plants need water to thrive. Here's how to water your air plants:

1. Water Quality: Air plants are sensitive to the chemicals present in tap water. You should avoid using tap water and opt for distilled, rain, or filtered water instead.

2. Soaking or Misting: There are two ways to water your air plants: soaking or misting. To soak your air plants, fill a bowl or sink with water and add a small amount of fertilizer. Soak the plant for 30 minutes to 1 hour, then remove it from the water and shake gently to remove excess water. Alternatively, you can mist your air plants once a week using a spray bottle. Be sure to mist them until they are soaked but not dripping wet.

3. Drying: After watering, allow your air plants to dry completely before placing them in their growing environment again. This can take anywhere from 4 to 6 hours.

Fertilizing Your Air Plants

Fertilizing your air plants is necessary to ensure they receive the nutrients they need to thrive. Here's how to fertilize your air plants:

1. Fertilizer: You can use either an air plant-specific fertilizer or orchid fertilizer. Mix the fertilizer with water per the instructions on the package.

2. Frequency: Fertilize your air plants once a month during their growing season (spring and summer) and once every two months during their dormant season (fall and winter).

3. Application: Apply the fertilizer solution to the base of the plant and let it soak in for a few minutes. Then, let the plant dry upside down to avoid any residual fertilizer in the leaves.

Trimming Your Air Plants

Trimming your air plants is essential to ensure they stay healthy and happy. Here's how to trim your air plants:

1. Dead Leaves: Remove any dead or yellow leaves from your air plants to avoid harboring bacteria or fungus.
